course_detail_blank_page.verification: Course Detail page now loads correctly with all sections visible

course_type_missing.root_cause: Courses in DB were missing course_type field
course_type_missing.fix_applied: Backend computes course_type from pricing if missing: 'live' if pricing.live exists, else 'recorded'
